summary: Plan work, prioritize requests, and protect focus with practical time management methods. Explore the course and build a workable weekly plan.
lede: Productivity training helps professionals turn competing tasks into a realistic plan by reviewing time use, setting priorities, and matching work to available capacity. Designed for people who plan, coordinate, or review day-to-day work, it develops practical skills in time auditing, using the Pareto Principle and ABCDE Method to prioritize, timeboxing calendar capacity, and recovering focus after interruptions.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for people who plan, complete, coordinate, or review day-to-day work and need a repeatable way to manage time, interruptions, and changing commitments.
prerequisites: Basic experience managing work tasks and deadlines is useful. No programming is required; exercises use written time logs, task records, and calendar-planning worksheets.
